actual_stored_projection_bodies.scope: All12 protocol fields, complete calculation/input/output, quality requirements/evidence, all measurement/property/unit bodies, source records, full row descriptions/amount evidence/basis/ranges, boundary/allocation/validation and reference fields. measurementRules.rule: Measure unique newly first-released complete net building mass Q with cp_release. Include integral concrete/steel/door/vent/finish and actual retained water once; exclude packaging. The reference representation is 1 kg; dispatched quantity and closing released FG are not separate new manufacture.

Preserve each row native unit and independent full wet mass. kWh * 3.6 = MJ once; integrate only true rates over observed time, never time-multiply an integrated volume. Volume-to-mass requires independent actual-substance density at measured temperature/pressure/composition. Count-to-mass uses independently measured actual configuration mass M with calibration and scope; Item(s) and item are factor-one count aliases. No building kg/item, floor area/height, thickness, density or service life is inferred from a secondary coefficient.

Collection captures undivided raw records. raw_units and attribute_vector prepare extensive A_i and full physical V_i before normalization. normalize_once performs A_i/Q_i or V_i/Q_i once; cards and aggregation only reference this same operation. Q_i=Q for manufacture and Q_i=Qc for actual original-cohort services; Q_i=0 retains all burdens with no unit result.

calculationRules.rule: Convert each original raw observation to its actual native extensive unit before attribution or product division. kWh * 3.6 = MJ once. Integrate true measured rates only; a cumulative volume is already integrated. Density must independently match that same substance/state; native secondary coefficients are not density measurements. Additional geometry/count conversions require actual configured measurements, no generic building mass.

After dedicated assignment/subdivision and justified causal or genuine residual allocation, manufacturing A_i = B_open_i + C_i + T_in_i - B_close_i - T_out_i in each exchange unit. B_close_i is only unreleased raw/WIP/unused-unassigned non-WIP; never released FG. Retain all failed Q=0 startup idle cleanup testing repair and treatment loads in C_i. State whether raw occurrence or stock-adjusted net issue is used and do not correct stocks twice. Each physical pool and each inherited exchange vector are independent. Original-cohort service A_service_i_c_H includes actual executed increments and carries only unused/unassigned stores. All physical movement legs keep full independent V_i, not this burden difference or a share.

a_i = A_i / Q_i; Q_i = Q for manufacturing or original Qc for actual original-cohort services over H. For a separately disclosed physical movement substitute full native V_i for A_i in this same division. Use Q_i once only; cards and protocol aggregation reference the same result, without another division. Q_i=0 keeps raw records, actual burdens and stocks with no unit result. finished_building is the fixed 1 kg representation of measured unique Q, not a second production or normalization.

O_M + R_M + F_to + J_M_in + H2O_M_in = C_M + Q_internal + F_back + E_M + J_M_out + H2O_M_out. All terms are complete actual wet kg at the manufacturing gate. O_M/C_M include raw/WIP/unreleased non-WIP and the actual production-asset/installed-fluid stocks physically inside this gate; the asset fleet is a non-additive subledger of these quantities. This gate excludes the separately owned packaging pool and net accepted FG states. R_M/E_M are disjoint complete actual inward/outward crossings of this gate, with every event flagged as a foreground-external transfer or an actual paired internal transfer. They include materials, utilities, gases, receiver wastes and real asset/part/fluid movements once. Q_internal is the unique net new-building first-release handoff; F_to/F_back are original-FG work handoffs, not new production. J_M/H2O_M are independently measured real non-water/water crossings not already contained in those whole legs, never closure residuals. All real internal transfers have matching source/destination IDs and cancel once in the foreground total; only foreground-external events remain exports/imports. Total mass/element closure does not assume each reacting species is conserved.

O_FG + Q_internal + R_FG + F_back + J_FG_in + H2O_FG_in = C_FG + G_FG + F_to + W_FG + samples_FG + J_FG_out + H2O_FG_out. O_FG/C_FG include all actual wet net accepted-building states on site: released stock, quarantine/hold, repair/rework and internal use with disjoint membership, separate from original Q0=Qc entitlement. Packages and production assets are excluded from these net-building states. Q_internal matches manufacture once; R_FG is full current-state external return, not the original historical delivery reversal. G_FG is gross net-building dispatch; W_FG and samples_FG are actual whole wet net-building exits. J_FG/H2O_FG are real independent non-water/water transfers not already in those legs, including retained additions and natural uptake/loss without repair. A real component transfer to this gate pairs with its source register; no repeated purchase/history. X only removes exact duplicate OTHER same-side raw observations, never a physical flow, C, Q or real increment. The package pool includes all empty/attached-WIP/attached-FG/reusable states: T_pack is only an internal change of attachment/location inside that pool, not another manufacturing/FG import/export. Combine the disjoint net-building and packaging views by cancelling Q_internal, F_to/F_back and every other true paired internal crossing once. Do not add asset or whole-article constituent subledgers again. Apply the separate complete calc_packaging material pools, then cancel actual matched internal package/asset transfers only once.

O + P + I + ER + J_in + H2O_in = C + S + EO + W + J_out + H2O_out. All terms are actual kg for one material/asset pool. O/C are complete wet opening/closing empty, attached WIP, attached FG and reusable stocks. P is new external procurement, I is disjoint supplier-included whole packaging ingress, ER external return received, S full gross shipment-attached export, EO independent external return sent, W whole wet discard. J_in/J_out are independently measured non-water repair/replacement/deposit/residue or other pool transfers not already in those whole legs. H2O_in/H2O_out are independently measured actual water transfers not already embodied in whole legs, including natural adsorption/desorption without repair. Split real wet added/removed materials into disjoint J and water from actual measurements, with no default ratio/density. Full W contains substrate, retained residues and water once; its nested children are not extra J_out/H2O_out unless actually separated before crossing. Matched internal pool transfers cancel without new purchase, service or Q.

Independently reconcile full wet mass, every relevant element and real molecular/particulate species in each phase. Separate free/absorbed water, chemically bound structural/reaction water, water vapour, liquid outlets and retained wet stock with independent tests and uncertainty. Hydration or carbonation is an actual independently evidenced reaction, never a default uptake/emission factor or residual that fits several unknowns. COD/VOC/NOx/PM measurements remain metrics unless independent speciation proves a named exchange.

measurementRules.rule: 用 cp_release 实测整栋新增唯一首次放行净质量 Q。内含混凝土钢件门通风器涂层及真实滞留水只计一次，包装排除。参考表示为 1 千克；发运数量及期末已放行成品不另造制造。
保留逐行原生单位及独立完整湿质量。kWh * 3.6 = MJ 仅一次；仅对真实速率按实测时间积分，不再对累计体积乘时间。体积质量换算须该物质在实测温度压力组成下独立密度。件数质量换算用独立实测配置质量 M，附校准和范围；Item(s) 与 item 为系数一的计数别名。不从次级系数推房屋件重楼面面积层高厚度密度或寿命。
采集保存未除原始记录。raw_units 和 attribute_vector 在归一化前准备广延 A_i 及完整物理 V_i。normalize_once 执行 A_i/Q_i 或 V_i/Q_i 一次，卡片及聚合仅引用该同一操作。制造 Q_i=Q，实际原批次服务 Q_i=Qc；Q_i=0 保留全部负荷但不出单位结果。

calculationRules.rule: 逐项原始观测在归属和除产品前换成真实原生广延单位。kWh * 3.6 = MJ 仅一次。只积分真实实测速率，累计体积已积分。密度须独立匹配该物质状态，原生次级系数不算密度实测。附加几何件数换算须真实配置测量，不设通用房屋重量。

专属细分及合理因果或真实剩余分配后，制造逐交换单位 A_i = B_open_i + C_i + T_in_i - B_close_i - T_out_i。B_close_i 仅未放行原料在制品未用未分配非在制品，不含已放行成品。C_i 保留失败 Q=0 启动空转清理试验修补处理全部负荷。声明原总发生或已调库存净领用，不重复调库存。每个实物池与每个继承交换向量独立。原批次 A_service_i_c_H 含真实已执行增量，仅未用未分配存货结转。所有实物流动腿保持独立完整 V_i，不用该负荷差或份额替代。
a_i = A_i / Q_i；制造 Q_i = Q，原批次 H 内真实服务 Q_i = 原 Qc。单独披露实物流时在同一次除法中用完整原生 V_i 替 A_i。Q_i 只除一次，卡片协议聚合引用同结果而不再除。Q_i=0 保留原始记录真实负荷库存，不出单位结果。finished_building 为实测唯一 Q 的固定 1 千克表示，不是第二次生产或归一化。

O_M + R_M + F_to + J_M_in + H2O_M_in = C_M + Q_internal + F_back + E_M + J_M_out + H2O_M_out。各项均为制造门完整真实湿 kg。O_M/C_M 含原材在制未放行非在制及本门内真实生产资产安装液体；台群是这些实物量的非加和子账。本门排除另归属包装池及净已接受成品状态。R_M/E_M 为本门互斥完整真实入出跨界，每事件标明前景外部或真实配对内部转移，材料公用气体接收废物和真实资产零件液体各一次。Q_internal 为唯一新建筑首次放行净质量交接，F_to/F_back 为原成品作业交接，不是新生产。J_M/H2O_M 为独立实测且未内含整腿的真实非水水跨界，不配残差。真实内部转移均有源目的地标识配对，在前景总账抵消一次，仅前景外部事件保留为入出流。总质量元素闭合不推各反应物种守恒。

O_FG + Q_internal + R_FG + F_back + J_FG_in + H2O_FG_in = C_FG + G_FG + F_to + W_FG + samples_FG + J_FG_out + H2O_FG_out。O_FG/C_FG 含全部真实净湿已接受建筑在厂状态：放行、隔离保留、维修返工、内部使用，成员互斥，独立于原 Q0=Qc 权益。净建筑状态排除包装和生产资产。Q_internal 与制造配对一次，R_FG 为完整现态外部返还，不是原交付历史冲回。G_FG 为净建筑毛发运，W_FG 和 samples_FG 为真实整湿净建筑出口。J_FG/H2O_FG 是未含于整腿的独立真实非水水转移，含留存新增及无维修自然吸失湿。真实部件转入与源账配对，不重复采购历史。X 仅消重同侧其他精确原始重复观测，不是实物流，不冲 C、Q 或真实增量。包装池含全部空、附在制、附成品和周转状态，T_pack 仅为本池内部附着位置改变，不是另一制造成品入出流。互斥净建筑和包装视图合并时将 Q_internal、F_to/F_back 及其他真实配对内部跨界抵消一次，不再加台群或整制品组分子账。 另用完整 calc_packaging 材质池，再将真实配对内部包装资产转移抵消一次。

O + P + I + ER + J_in + H2O_in = C + S + EO + W + J_out + H2O_out。各项均为同一材质或资产池的真实 kg。O/C 为完整湿态期初期末空、附在制、附成品和周转库存。P 为新增外采，I 为互斥供方随货整包装入向，ER 为收到外部返还，S 为随完整毛发运带出，EO 为独立向外返还，W 为整湿废弃物。J_in/J_out 为独立实测且未含于上述整物方向的非水修理、替换、沉积、残留或其他跨池转移。H2O_in/H2O_out 为独立实测且未内含于整物方向的真实水转移，含无修理的自然吸脱湿。真实新增或移除湿材料须按实测拆为互斥 J 和水，不设默认比例或密度。完整 W 已含基材、留存残余及水一次，除非跨界前真实分离，其嵌套子项不另列 J_out/H2O_out。配对内部池转移合并时抵消，不新增采购、服务或 Q。
在每个相态分别独立核对完整湿质量、相关元素及真实分子颗粒物种。用独立试验不确定性区分游离吸附水、化学结合结构反应水、水蒸气、液体出口及滞留湿库存。水化或碳化须独立证据证明真实反应，不是默认吸收排放因子或拟合多未知的残差。COD/VOC/NOx/PM 测量仍为指标，除非独立物种鉴定证明具体交换。

collectionProtocols.collection_method: 按序列追踪原整栋，当前湿实物流、原交付冲回及制造历史分别记录。计量全部已执行服务，包括期末留库成品和真实返工；各真实投入物种废物均按原批次另记。未知未来服务和复验不造 Q。 最终汇总定义：原生广延原始记录保持未除；先对账数量及合理归属，再引用 normalize_once 的同一次操作报告每参考流。 保留完整原始实物量、独立真实负荷向量及各自有供方历史一次；整湿接收 Qt 不是批次份额，原正值 Q0=Qc 与零产出 Q=0 分开。 真实 J_FG/H2O_FG 是独立实物转移，X_in/out 仅为同侧其他精确重复观测，不是实物增量或库存修正。

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 核实真实产品制剂材料等级路线形态聚合物 CAS 地域相态介质类型及完整原生属性链；采用官方名不等于供方批准，UUID 空缺仍保留单一具体交换。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整原生直读及支持证据；真实 BOM 供方匹配

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 证明具屋面地板全部墙体门通风器及真实完工状态的完整储物建筑，并有真实非预应力焊接接缝图纸。构件或通用现场建造不能确立该门。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 整件供货资料；实际图纸；完整验收称重记录

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 全部失败零产出区间试验清理返工及真实物理进出口保留，识别缺少的真实卡与未明数量，不报为零。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 作业库存账；计量对账；不确定性登记

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 每个实物库存与每个继承交换向量各自完整；产品包装资产部件流体及真实载体返还保持完整总流动。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 独立制造成品包装合并门；元素水分试验

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 保持来源版本完整适用上下文，制造商数值限值不是清单默认值，不同出版物不是同 SKU。工业制造证据不确立分配。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整原件及有界核验上下文；来源用途判断；归因 ILCD 范围

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 测真实场址时期配置及原 Qc/H，不编造未来服务配方尺寸密度件重寿命性能良率或排放因子。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 同期实测记录；真实试验状态及明确缺口
